(Currently amended) A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a first value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order, wherein the first value is a quantity corresponding to a feature of the first primitive graphic element; and based on the comparison of the first value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements.

(Currently amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value is a numerical representation of a size of a bounding box around the first and second primitive graphic elements.

(Currently amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value represents a size of a minimum bounding box that encompasses the first and second primitive graphic elements.

(Currently amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 28, wherein the size of the minimum bounding box is calculated as a sum of a width and height of the bounding box divided by a sum of a width and height of a page containing the primitive graphic elements.

(Currently amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 28, wherein the size of the minimum bounding box is calculated as a ratio of the area of the bounding box divided by the area of a page containing the primitive graphic elements.

(Currently amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the set of instructions for calculating comprises a set of instructions for determining a distinct value for each pair of primitive graphic elements subsequent in the drawing order, wherein the set of instructions for defining the single structural graphic element comprises sets of instructions for: utilizing the calculated values for pairs of primitive graphic elements to identify clusters of primitive graphic elements as candidates for joining as compound graphic elements; and identifying sequences of primitive graphic elements within a cluster whose bounding boxes intersect; and joining the sequences as unified graphic elements.

(Currently amended) A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document; based on values calculated for successive pairs of primitive graphic elements, defining a set of responsive primitive graphic elements as a candidate compound graphic element; using boundaries of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more groups of primitive graphic elements within the set; and defining each particular group having more than one primitive graphic element as a single structural graphic element within the document, the structural graphic element comprising the primitive graphic elements in the grouped set.

(Currently amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 32, wherein the set of instructions for defining the set of responsive primitive graphic elements comprises conducting cluster analysis on the calculated values.

(Currently amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 32, wherein the set of instructions for using boundaries of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more groups of primitive graphic elements comprises sets of instructions for: selecting a first graphic element in the cluster and assigning the graphic element to a new sub-group; assigning a second graphic element in the cluster to the sub-group when a bounding box of the second graphic element overlaps a bounding box of the sub-group.

(Currently amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 34, wherein the set of instructions for using boundaries of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more groups of primitive graphic elements further comprises a set of instructions for assigning a third graphic element to a second sub-group when a bounding box of the third graphic element does not overlap the bounding box of the sub-group.

(Currently amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 34, wherein the bounding box of the sub-group is a combination of the bounding boxes of all primitive graphic elements already in the sub-group.

(Currently amended) A method for analyzing a document, the method comprising: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a first value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order, wherein the first value is a quantity corresponding to a feature of the first primitive graphic element; and based on the comparison of the first value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements.

(Currently amended) The method of claim 37, wherein the first value represents a numerical representation of a size of a minimum bounding box that encompasses the first and second primitive graphic elements.

(Currently amended) The method of claim 38, wherein the size of the minimum bounding box is calculated as a sum of a width and height of the bounding box divided by a sum of a width and height of a page containing the primitive graphic elements.

(Currently amended) The method of claim 38, wherein the size of the minimum bounding box is calculated as a ratio of the area of the bounding box divided by the area of a page containing the primitive graphic elements.

(Currently amended) The method of claim 37, wherein the calculating comprises determining a distinct value for each pair of primitive graphic elements subsequent in the drawing order, wherein defining the single structural graphic element comprises: using calculated values for pairs of primitive graphic elements to identify clusters of primitive graphic elements as candidates for joining as compound graphic elements; and identifying sequences of primitive graphic elements within a cluster whose bounding boxes intersect; and joining the sequences as unified graphic elements.

(Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: a set of processing units; and a machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document; based on values calculated for successive pairs of primitive graphic elements, defining a set of responsive primitive graphic elements as a candidate compound graphic element; using boundaries of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more groups of primitive graphic elements within the set; and defining each particular group having more than one primitive graphic element as a single structural graphic element within the document, the structural graphic element comprising the primitive graphic elements in the grouped set.

(Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 42, wherein the set of instructions for using boundaries of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more groups of primitive graphic elements comprises sets of instructions for: selecting a first graphic element in the cluster and assigning the graphic element to a new sub-group; assigning a second graphic element in the cluster to the sub-group when a bounding box of the second graphic element overlaps a bounding box of the sub-group.

(Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 43, wherein the set of instructions for using boundaries of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more groups of primitive graphic elements further comprises a set of instructions for assigning a third graphic element to a second sub-group when a bounding box of the third graphic element does not overlap the bounding box of the sub-group.

(Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 43, wherein the bounding box of the sub-group is a combination of the bounding boxes of all primitive graphic elements already in the sub-group.

(Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 42, wherein the document comprises a vector graphics document that is not pre-structured.
